retrievedNote: Latest download time among cached node files (file mtime); generated is the time this manifest was written.

aoi.definition: Provisional Lot 1 bbox + 200 m, snapped to the 2 m lattice aligned with DEM pixel edges, clipped to DEM extent.

selection: Every EPT node at every depth whose XY box intersects the AOI (EPSG:3857 +2 m); full density, depths 0-11.
classNote: Classes 17/18/25 behave as side-overlap copies of 1/2/9 (base + 16): class 17 heights above the DEM match class 1, class 18 matches class 2 within centimetres, 25 matches water. The project report and FGDC metadata label 17 bridge decks and 18 high noise and say overlap classes were used to trip the withheld bit; the EPT carries no withheld/overlap flag. Interpreted empirically; the script fails if that behaviour changes.

horizontal.method: EPT XY (EPSG:3857, WGS84 Pseudo-Mercator) -> EPSG:26918 with PROJ default pipeline (pyproj 3.8.0); WGS84 and NAD83 treated as coincident (ballpark), matching how the EPT was built from NAD83 UTM source tiles

sourceGridResidualCm.note: Distance of reprojected X from the 0.01 m grid of the original LAS tiles, in cm units. Uniform noise would give a median near 0.25; values near 0 indicate exact inversion of the EPT build reprojection.

vertical.eptZ: EPT schema Z: int32, scale 0.001, offset 666; srs block declares horizontal EPSG:3857 only (no vertical code).
vertical.interpretation: EPT Z matches the NAVD88 (Geoid12A) DEM to within centimetres: heights are the source orthometric metres passed through unchanged, not ellipsoidal (NY geoid undulation is about -32 m). No correction applied.
vertical.caveat: The DEM was interpolated from these same ground returns, so agreement checks datum/consistency only, not absolute accuracy.

gitignore: sources/dannemora/lidar/ept-data/*.laz is ignored; re-download with scripts/prepare-site-3d.py and verify sha256 below.
